meta.decisions: D31 (ensembles/floors/LORO), D32 (two arms), D15 (floor estimator), D29 (blind dipole_p1)
meta.tranche: 1 of the stage-B ladder: (10,10) at 0.01 and 0.05 V/A, 3 runs each; zero-field side = stage-A zf_cnt10_b{1,2,3}
meta.lift_options: lift_frame(mode="auto"), NO field= (blind), T=300.0, one composition dialect for every frame

subsampling.note: arm 2 reads every frame (dense); arm 1 lifts the stride subsample; identical subsample indices on both arms

block_protocol.zf_blocks: 2 x 1 ns per run (the zf runs are 2 ns; floors from cross-run pairs)

meta.floor_estimator: D15 max(mean, P90) over |delta| between zf block pairs from different runs (12 pairs)

0.01.feature: dipole_p1 (the blind statement's value; the direct arm uses the same quantity without chaord)

0.05.feature: dipole_p1 (the blind statement's value; the direct arm uses the same quantity without chaord)
